summary: Buying has broadened through the morning, lifting benchmarks clear of 22,600 with smallcaps outpacing midcaps as risk appetite improves ahead of the RBI decision.

watch: Holding above the 22,600–22,621 resistance zone into expiry
Smallcap index up 0.65% vs midcap up 0.29%
